currentValue.rule: An estimator's identity, emotion, demographic, gaze, or other person-related label is an inference, not an established fact about a person. Report the method/model identity and version, evidence/reference, applicable scope, uncertainty, and known limitations; abstain when the evidence is ambiguous, out of scope, or lacks required authority. Anonymous track identity does not identify a person, and diarization alone does not establish speaker identity. Do not assert ground truth from a model label or promote it to a person record without separate authorization and evidence.

anonymousTrackIdsByDefault.preference: When a task needs to associate observations of the same subject within one authorized asset, stream, or explicitly scoped session but does not require identifying the person, prefer a random, non-semantic track identifier whose scope is limited to that asset/version or session. Do not create a reusable cross-tenant or global identity key merely to keep a track label stable.
anonymousTrackIdsByDefault.identityResolution: Resolve or persist a person identity only when the exact operation requires it and current purpose-specific authority and any applicable consent are established. If identity is unnecessary, unavailable, ambiguous, or unauthorized, retain the scoped track identifier or abstain; do not substitute a person label.
anonymousTrackIdsByDefault.privacyLimit: A scoped track identifier is not automatically anonymous if it can be linked with other data. Do not claim de-identification or anonymization from using a track ID alone; apply the separate authorized de-identification process and its evidence when that claim is needed.
